claim_contract.all_zero: Emit an internally cross-evaluated exact bounded-dictionary nonmembership candidate, pending independent external replay and promotion. This is not a global CPWL identity or unrestricted network lower bound.
claim_contract.some_nonzero: Serialize the complete signed price vector as guidance only. It proves neither membership nor nonmembership, filters no column, and authorizes no quotient computation in this source.

no_claim: This registration covers only complete exact pricing of the frozen same-component family. It contains no quotient solver, no modular membership decision, no rational coefficient lift, no global identity proof, no unrestricted ReLU lower bound, and no novelty or priority claim.

price_stage.exact_arithmetic: Clear all 230 raw-row denominators by one common LCM, divide by one global gcd only, preserve signed primitive integer weights, and perform no coordinatewise row-gcd or modular division.
price_stage.independent_evaluator: direct nested-max replay over every support-row/column entry
price_stage.serialized_fields: ordered exact prices, ordered prices modulo 1000003, local/global IDs, representative hashes, topology, orientation, orbit-class size, exact/modular counts and first indices, vector gcds, exact target pairing, evaluator hashes

target: Compute and serialize the exact G-0078 functional price of every one of the 18,582 frozen same-component Y-spoke representatives in the bound order, together with the nonzero exact target pairing.
